audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on Heroic Swing or Comeuppance, and nothing on the fact that his grapple needs terrain or that Kayle has no dash to escape a cut-off.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 and only works off terrain, so open lane denies it; Comeuppance stores bullets on a locked target at 100/85/70 and Divine Judgment blanks the release.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and both donts now carry the numbers, the terrain requirement and the Flash rule.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5 — step up only while it is on cooldown.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: You have no dash, so hold Flash for his Heroic Swing cut-off, not for damage.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — the hook needs terrain, so fight in the open lane. - Comeuppance: 100s, it stores bullets on a locked target — break line of sight or pop R. - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — kill windows only.
